tool.old_text:
# Load grid data
    xyz, n = _get_grid_data(file_paths[GRID_FILE])

    # Initialize variables for additional data
    flow_type = nothing
    basis_functions = nothing
    base_flow = nothing
    built_basis_functions = nothing
    built_base_flow = nothing
    variables = nothing
    amplitudes = nothing
    time_steps = nothing
    ki = nothing
    ai = nothing
    ku = nothing
    U = nothing

    # Load from eigenstate_info.h5
    h5open(file_paths[EIGENSTATE_INFO_FILE], "r") do file
        ki_matrix = read(file["ki"])
        ai_matrix = read(file["ai"])
        # Convert to Vector{Point3f}
        ki = [Point3f(ki_matrix[i, 1], ki_matrix[i, 2], ki_matrix[i, 3]) for i in 1:size(ki_matrix, 1)]
        ai = [Point3f(ai_matrix[i, 1], ai_matrix[i, 2], ai_matrix[i, 3]) for i in 1:size(ai_matrix, 1)]
        U = read(file["base_flow"]["U"])
        ku = read(file["base_flow"]["ku"])
        flow_type = read(file["flow_type"])
    end

    # Load from amplitudes.h5
    h5open(file_paths[AMPLITUDES_FILE], "r") do file
        amplitudes = read(file["vel_data"])
    end

    # Load from time_data.h5
    h5open(file_paths[TIME_DATA_FILE], "r") do file
        time_steps = read(file["time_data"])
    end

    # Load from basis_function_registry.h5
    h5open(file_paths[BASIS_FUNCTION_REGISTRY_FILE], "r") do file
        functions = read(file[flow_type])

        # Fetch the basis functions and the base flow
        basis_functions = functions["basis_function"]
        base_flow = functions["base_flow"]

        # Get the variables for the functions and set them in the
        # VelFieldCalc module's namespace and save for later use
        vars = functions["variables"]
        variables = Dict(var => Symbolics.variable(var) for var in vars)

        # Order the variables how we are going to pass them to the functions
        # we build later. This is important as incorrect variable order will result
        # in incorrect function evaluations/calculations
        vars_ordered = ["x", "y", "z", "kx", "ky", "kz", "ax", "ay", "az", "ku", "U"]
        function_vars = [variables[var] for var in vars_ordered]

        # Now parse the equations and build functions for evaluating
        # each basis function and the base flow and store them in dictionaries
        built_basis_functions = Dict{String, Function}()
        built_base_flow = Dict{String, Function}()

        # Convert the basis functions to symbolic expressions
        for (label, expr) in basis_functions
            parsed_expr = Meta.parse(expr)
            symbolic_expr = Symbolics.parse_expr_to_symbolic(parsed_expr, DataManager)
            built_basis_functions[label] = eval(Symbolics.build_function(symbolic_expr, function_vars...; expression=true, wrap_module=false, kwargs=true))
        end

        # Convert the base flow to symbolic expressions
        for (label, expr) in base_flow
            parsed_expr = Meta.parse(expr)
            symbolic_expr = Symbolics.parse_expr_to_symbolic(parsed_expr, DataManager)
            built_base_flow[label] = eval(Symbolics.build_function(symbolic_expr, function_vars...; expression=true, wrap_module=false, kwargs=true))
        end
    end
